profile.headline: Specialist in Statistics & Information Technology
profile.summary: Specialist in Statistics and Informatics with experience such as Information System Programmer Analyst, Statistical information analyst (descriptive / inferential statistical analysis), Data processing and advice on computer aspects, Technical support for the design of samples, survey information gathering, Design and elaboration of the Systems,  Modification of programs of the Remuneration System, Costs and Budgets of Works, Kardex Application Design, Development of the application of the Actuarial Model, Database design for electoral processes, Technical support in Humanitarian Assistance, Application developer for Windows and Web (Responsive, Bootstrap), Application developer with .Net 5 C# language, HTML5 CSS3, Javascript, jQuery.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Software developer for the web, analysis and database processing, elaboration of syntax/SPSS code for the issuance of tables, using tools such as Net 5, SqlServer 2019, Visual Studio 2019, HTML, jQuery, BootStrap, JavaScript.

positions.title: Systems Analyst Programmer
positions.locationName: Jr. Cuzco 121 – 8vo piso - Cercado, Lima – Perú.
positions.description: Developer of Applications for Windows and Web sites. Preparation of programs (C # language) to support the sales system, designing and developing computer solutions in the elaboration of information systems, database management and in the use of new information technologies.

positions.title: Specialist in Statistics and Information Technology
positions.locationName: Calle Primavera 226, Urb. José Galvez – Independencia, Lima – Perú.
positions.description: Management and processing of database, statistical analysis of the project information from public and private investment for the construction of transport routes national, departmental, neighborhood and sanitation infrastructure and buildings in general. Formulation and evaluation of public and private investment projects.

positions.title: Social Economic Technician
positions.locationName: Av. General Garzon 654 - Jesus Maria – Lima – Perú.
positions.description: Database Analyst, data processing, analysis and preparation of reports for consistency of the database, elaboration of syntax/SPSS code for the issuance of tabulations, for the project of the "National Survey of Peruvian Youth - ENAJUV 2011".

positions.title: Information Technology Officer
positions.description: Data processing and statistical analysis for electoral process. Design, development and modification of database management of voter registration, and information analysis and generation of reports for consistency of the database, election results, and other support to the database. Development of programs for analysis and reporting. Monitoring and follow-up to the security of the database.

positions.title: Electoral Officer
positions.locationName: Obrigado Barracks, Caicoli - UNMIT Headquarters / Dili, East Timor (ASIA)
positions.description: Technical support and assistance in information technology to the CNE for the electoral process. Technical support for the presentation of the HONDT method which determines the number of parliamentary seats obtained by political parties. Training to the local technicians of the CNE in MS Office. Development of statistical application of the "results of the Parliamentary Elections of 2007". Technical support in the configuration and administration of personal computers, distribution of systems and software of the United Nations.

positions.title: Specialist in Statistics and Information Technology
positions.locationName: Av. Alfredo Mendiola 6298-B, Urb. Santa Luisa, Los Olivos – Lima – Perú.
positions.description: Planning and control of the production, updating of the prices of the products, marketing, supervision and monitoring of the attention to the orders to the clients. Development of software for the control of the production and sales of hoses for automobiles. Data processing and statistical analysis.

positions.title: Information Technology Consultant
positions.description: Support and assistance to the CEN/GTE in base of information technology policies for the electoral process. Supervision and verification of modifications done in the database. Statistics elaboration (software EPI-Info) referred to the electoral population, in order to inform citizens about statistical information of the Legislative Elections of 2002. Support in the organization of electoral report and kit's by way of making identification stickers (in Visual Fox Pro v 6) for their easy of recognition. Modification (forms, reports) of the software (in Visual Fox Pro v.6) "Partial Results of the 2002 Legislative Elections" for the counting and the registry of the certificate of election from voting sites. Supervision and monitoring of the Partial Results, which comprises the management of what has been done to the certificate of elections from the voting sites, entering and processing data in order to obtain results by the computer Drawing maps and charts of the Partial Results of elections.

positions.title: Specialist Statistics and Informatics
positions.description: Collect statistics data for development the Planning and Program about of Agriculture (Palm Oil, Camu Camu, Palmito and Amazonia). Supervision and monitor of Agriculture Project. Data Base design about development Institutions and Project in the Amazonian (Visual Fox Pro v 6.0). Data Base design for the monitor of Agriculture Project (Visual Fox Pro v 6.0).

positions.title: Computer Advisor
positions.description: Computer consultancy for the consistency of data and modification of programs for simulations of the Actuarial model (programming in FoxPro). Design and development of the Computer application for the Actuarial Model (Visual FoxPro v 6).

positions.title: Humanitarian Assistance Officer
positions.description: Supporting the Registration of UNITA quartered soldiers, Technical support to the Registration Program. Technical support on the installation of computer net wares and support to solve hardware/software problems in different provinces. Technical assistance in the consistency of data of the system of registry of the military (EPI-INFO software). Data Base design to generate directory of ONG's and Data processing (FoxPro DOS). Statistical analysis and graphics elaboration of NGO's directory. Acting DRTO (Demobilization Reintegration Technical Officer). Logistic in Andulo Quartering Area, distribution food and non-food items to the soldiers. Planning and implementing the Humanitarian Assistance program for the Demobilized soldiers.

positions.title: Electoral Officer
positions.description: Verify the impartiality of the provincial and district commission in all aspects and stages of the electoral process. Verify that political parties enjoy complete freedom of organization, movement, assembly and expression without intimidation. Participate in the electoral education campaign, liaise with organizations involved in civic education at district and communal level. Data processing on different kinds of questionnaires referred to the electoral process. Programming and distribution of electoral materials. Assistance to the international electoral observer in the logistics matters. Execution and verification of automatic data processing at provincial level (results of voting pools).

educations.schoolName: Universidad de San Martín de Porres

educations.degreeName: Development and Deployment of Layered Solutions with C#.
educations.fieldOfStudy: Software development in ASP NET MVC

volunteerExperiences.description: ANGOLA (Africa). Technical support in the Registration Program for UNITA military quarters. Installation and maintenance of computer networks in a Windows for WorkGroups environment (hardware and software). Technical assistance in data processing and analysis of information from the Military Registration System (in FoxPro and EPI-INFO). Design of the Database for the registration of NGOs, data processing and statistical analysis. Logistic support in cantonment areas, in the reception, storage and distribution of food and other items for the UNITA military.
